public.aboutDesc: AgriTrace records farm-to-table events in an immutable timeline. Farmers publish operational data, inspectors validate quality checkpoints, and public users verify trust from QR code.
public.sourceTransparencyDesc: Every batch starts from a real farm and product mapping, reducing fake origin claims.
public.inspectorGateDesc: Inspection events create a clear quality-control checkpoint before public trust is asserted.
public.publicVerificationDesc: QR/code lookup exposes sanitized timeline and integrity status without requiring login.
public.immutableTimeline: Immutable timeline from cultivation to distribution.
public.verifiedDescription: Inspection gate is present and published records passed integrity checks.
public.compromisedDescription: At least one integrity check failed. Review this batch before trusting it.
public.awaitingInspectionDescription: Trace exists but inspection gate has not been published yet.
public.noPublicDataDescription: No trace records are available for public verification.
public.hashSignaturePass: Hash chain and signature checks passed.
public.tamperingRisk: One or more integrity checks detected data tampering risk.
